how_to_run: Give each prompt (and fixture) to two fresh agent sessions, one with the kit installed and one without. A domain expert who does not know which is which scores both blueprints 1-10 on: correctness of the recommendation, whether a simpler baseline was considered fairly, evidence quality (real sources, no invented numbers), cost realism (dated prices), and whether the evaluation plan would actually catch a bad system. Tick every grader with evidence. Record results in evals/RESULTS.md.

cases.fixture: SaaS repo with a customers.csv (12k rows, churn label, signup_date) and no ML yet
cases.prompt: Add AI to predict which customers will churn next month.
graders: Profiler run; time-based split chosen because of signup_date
A GBDT/linear baseline is planned and the deep/LLM option has to beat it
Decision engine run on ≥3 candidates; weights justified
Evaluation uses cost-weighted metrics at the operating threshold, sized with estimate.mjs sample
cases.expected: A pragmatic GBDT-first blueprint with an honest comparison, not an LLM by default.

cases.fixture: Help-centre markdown (400 articles) and ticket export
cases.prompt: Design an AI assistant that answers customer support questions from our docs.
graders: Case studies of production support assistants cited
models.mjs cost run for ≥2 model sizes with dated prices
Golden set with retrieval metrics and assertions; judge calibration planned
redteam.mjs set included with a 100% pass gate; tools need confirmation
cases.expected: RAG design with retrieval evaluation, cheap-model-first routing, red-team gate and a system card.

cases.fixture: Factory line brief: 2 cameras, 30 fps, 50 ms budget, 300 labelled defect images
cases.prompt: What AI should we use to detect defects on our line?
graders: Latency budget drives an edge architecture; inference estimated
Synthetic data or simulation decision documented either way
Per-condition slices (lighting, product variant) in the evaluation
cases.expected: Edge anomaly-detection-first design with a data plan and slice-aware evaluation.

cases.fixture: An existing LLM feature with prompt v1 and v2 and a 60-case golden set
cases.prompt: Is prompt v2 better than v1?
graders: Answer states the delta, its interval and the McNemar p-value
Says "not proven" if the difference is not significant
cases.expected: A measured answer, not an opinion.
